long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as an engineer, Francesco Gaetano Caltagirone developed apartment complexes in Rome before acquiring the Vianini infrastructure and cement-products group in 1984. He reorganised Vianini into a listed holding, then added Cementir, creating an industrial platform that extended beyond residential development into construction materials and major works.

Publishing provided another operating arm. Acquisitions including Il Messaggero and Il Mattino were consolidated under Caltagirone Editore, while Cementir expanded internationally. Caltagirone remains chairman of the parent holding, which directs stakes across these separately constituted companies and additional financial investments. His wealth is primarily tied to shares in listed companies and other investment vehicles, rather than direct ownership of their operating assets.
